Lightning streaks through the ominous clouds, and creatures created by the Black Mage appear without end.|In-game description for Moonbridge}} '''Moonbridge''' is the first major area in [[Tenebris]]. Moonbridge is the term that the [[Alliance]] uses to describe the foggy and stormy path to the Black Moon, which became the Black Sun Tenebris after the ritual in [[Esfera]]. In order to reach the [[Black Mage]], the [[Alliance]] fleet must fight past the dark Erda creatures being created by the [[Giant Monster Gloom]]. This region can be accessed on foot via the small airship at the [[Outpost]]. It is generally divided into three sections: '''Last Horizon''', '''Mysterious Fog''', and '''Void Current''', with each section being unlocked as you progress through the questline. Each section requires a certain amount of Arcane Power to deal normal damage to the monsters here, with '''Last Horizon''' requiring 670, '''Mysterious Fog''' requiring 700, and '''Void Current''' requiring 730. The final boss for this area is [[Giant Monster Gloom#Moonbridge|Gloom]], a giant Erda monster created by the [[Black Mage]] as the gatekeeper to Tenebris. Completing the questline will reward the [[Medal]]s {{IconLink|image=Eqp Emblem of the Alliance|Emblem of the Alliance}} and {{IconLink|image=Eqp Void Vanquisher|Void Vanquisher}} and unlock access to the [[Giant Monster Gloom#Moonbridge|Giant Monster Gloom]] Boss Battle. In addition, [[(Daily Quest) Moonbridge Research|Daily Quests]] are unlocked which grant additional EXP. All [[Esfera]] and [[Sellas]] monsters (excluding Flying / Anti-AFK monsters) will drop {{IconLink|image=Etc Stone Origin Droplet|Stone Origin Droplet}}s at a very low chance. In '''Heroic / Reboot Worlds''', Moonbridge, [[Labyrinth of Suffering]], and [[Limina]] monsters will also drop these, and they are also sold for 50,000,000 [[Meso]]s each at General Store NPCs in [[Esfera]] and above [[Arcane River]] areas, up to [[Limina]]. [[Stone Origin Droplet]]s and {{IconLink|image=Etc Stone Cobweb Droplet|Stone Cobweb Droplet}}s (dropped by [[Will/Monster#Esfera|Will]]) can be exchanged for {{IconLink|image=Etc Arachno Coin|Arachno Coin}}s at a 9:1 ratio by talking to [[Kanto#Arachno Coins|Kanto]] in [[Base Camp]], and these are subsequently used to purchase '''Level 200 [[Arcane Umbra Set|Arcane Umbra Weapons, Hats, Overalls, and Shoulders]]''' from [[Dimo#Arachno Coins|Dimo]]. Defeating Giant Monster Gloom allows players to obtain the following: *The [[Earrings]] {{IconLink|image=Eqp Estella Earrings|Estella Earrings}}, which is part of the [[Dawn Boss Set]] ('''Normal''' and '''Chaos''' mode) *{{IconLink|image=Use Arcane Umbra Weapon Box|Arcane Umbra Weapon Box}}, which allows players to obtain a '''Level 200 [[Arcane Umbra Set|Arcane Umbra Weapon]]''' of one's choice ('''Chaos''' mode only) *{{IconLink|image=Use Arcane Umbra Armor Box|Arcane Umbra Armor Box}}, which allows players to obtain a '''Level 200 [[Arcane Umbra Set|Arcane Umbra Hat, Overall, Shoulder, Shoe, Glove, or Cape]]''' of one's choice ('''Chaos''' mode only) *The [[Ring]] {{IconLink|image=Eqp Endless Terror|Endless Terror}}, which is part of the [[Pitched Boss Set]] ('''Chaos''' mode only) ==World Map== '''Click on a dot to view a map's page.'''

Mob Gloom Core.png|[[Gloom Core#Moonbridge Quest|Gloom Core]] ==Story== '''For information on the full story, visit [[Moonbridge/Story|this page]].''' With the final battle approaching, the [[Adversary]] and the [[Esfera]] base camp were called back to [[Ereve]], where the Adversary was filled in on the situation by [[Neinheart]]. Neinheart explained that immense chains were pulling [[Maple World]] closer into the [[Arcane River]], with powerful Erda monsters attacking various parts of the world. He revealed that the Alliance had recovered several prophecies from the [[Black Mage]]'s laboratory in [[Magatia]], which foretold many key events in Maple World's history, such as [[Black Heaven]] and the [[Dark World Tree]] incident. Neinheart then showed the final prophecy written upon it: '''They who cross the breath of twilight and turn towards the sun,''' '''on broken wings will be crushed and undone by despair.''' '''A light whose brilliant glory is lost''' '''will face the soul of the world whilst steeped in mire and rot.''' '''A crimson tear will spawn a giant that swallows hearts,''' '''and when determination is swallowed by the deepest dark,''' '''a new destiny will be written, a destiny apart.''' Consumed with nightmares about their predetermined destiny, [[Cygnus|Empress Cygnus]] had sought out [[Shinsoo]] in [[Leafre]], where Shinsoo had given her a diadem containing her [[Ancient God|divine power]]. Following this, Cygnus had put out a call to the Alliance to gather for the final battle. Neinheart took the Adversary to the [[Outpost]], a large floating island where the '''White Spear''' - the Alliance flagship - was docked. Neinheart also revealed that Shinsoo had told them that the '''determination of countless people''' was needed in order to achieve victory, and that the Alliance had recovered a final writing by the Black Mage recovered from Magatia, which simply stated: “'''Only the Adversary can counter immortality's fate with the strength of a [[Seal Stone]].'''” The united Alliance fleet then launched alongside the White Spear through a portal that led to the Arcane River. The fleet then set sail along Moonbridge, the name that the Alliance had given to the path that bridged Esfera and the Black Moon, before it had become the Black Sun. Along the way, they began battling the Erda creatures which had been assailing Maple World. Soon enough, they encountered the [[Giant Monster Gloom]], whose eye unleashed a powerful laser that decimated a large majority of the fleet, despite Cygnus' attempts to create a shield of light with her unawakened [[Transcendent]] powers and Shinsoo's strength. Though Cygnus' resolve was fading, the Adversary helped her regain her fortitude, allowing her to rally the Alliance forces so that the Adversary could defeat Gloom, whose core was recovered for study, as it had been formed from the Black Mage's thoughts. During transportation back to the Outpost, however, the core exploded, leaving Ollie - who had been in charge of recovering it - missing. {{References}} ==Availability== {{Availability |1=Available |2=Available |3=Available |4=Available |5=Available |6=Available }} {{Arcane River}} [[ko:문브릿지]] [[zh:月之橋]] [[Category:Tenebris]] [[Category:Moonbridge]]
